successCriteria.description: web/src/modules/approvals/approvals.service.ts declares and exports the `ApprovalsQueueItem` read-model type with exactly these fields: requestId: string, employeeId: string, employeeName: string | null, leaveTypeCode: LeaveTypeCode, startDate: Date, endDate: Date, status: LeaveStatus.

web/src/modules/approvals/approvals.service.ts declares the `IApprovalsService` interface exposing exactly `getQueue(): Promise<ApprovalsQueueItem[]>` and `decide(requestId: string, action: 'approve' | 'reject'): Promise<LeaveRequestView>`.

`ApprovalsService.getQueue()` returns only rows where `status === LeaveStatus.SUBMITTED` AND `employeeId !== profile.id`, where `profile` is obtained from `employeeService.getMe()`; every returned item has `employeeName === null` and `status === LeaveStatus.SUBMITTED`.

`ApprovalsService.decide(requestId, 'approve')` delegates to `leaveService.approve(requestId)` and returns the resulting `LeaveRequestView` unchanged; `decide(requestId, 'reject')` delegates to `leaveService.reject(requestId)` and returns its `LeaveRequestView` unchanged, without re-fetching the list.
web/src/modules/approvals/index.ts re-exports `IApprovalsService`, `ApprovalsService`, and the `ApprovalsQueueItem` type as the module's public entry point.

constraints: ApprovalsService must NOT import the api-client (web/src/infrastructure/api) directly; it obtains leave/employee operations only through the injected ILeaveService and IEmployeeService.
Do NOT redeclare LeaveTypeCode, LeaveStatus, LeaveRequestView, or EmployeeProfile; import them from web/src/shared/types/index.ts.
Do NOT add a status query parameter or any new api-client method; the API contract is unchanged. getQueue() filters client-side and decide() reuses the existing approve/reject methods.
Do NOT attempt employee-name resolution; ApprovalsQueueItem.employeeName must be null (no endpoint returns another employee's name).
Role is obtained from the EmployeeProfile returned by employeeService.getMe(), never decoded from the JWT.
outOfScope: Unit tests for the approvals service (Phase 2), the RequireApprover route guard (Phase 3), ApprovalsPage + route wiring (Phase 4), and ApprovalsPage tests + dashboard link (Phase 5).
Any new api-client methods, status query parameters, or backend API changes; employee-name resolution (no endpoint exists).
UI/presentation rendering, route guards, and composition-root wiring (web/src/main.tsx) — these belong to later phases.

entityInvariants.invariant: A derived read-model projection, never persisted: membership is computed from LeaveRequestView rows where status === LeaveStatus.SUBMITTED and employeeId !== the signed-in viewer's id. While in the queue, status is always LeaveStatus.SUBMITTED and employeeName is always null.

A stateless orchestration boundary over ILeaveService and IEmployeeService; it performs no lifecycle transition itself, delegates decide() verbatim to leaveService.approve/reject, and returns the LeaveRequestView unchanged.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Identity/role derived from employeeService.getMe() profile; no JWT decoding. Returns [] for an empty queue (normal state, not an error).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Read-only; propagates rejections from getMe()/list() unchanged (no swallowing).

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Delegates to leaveService.approve/reject; authorization is enforced by the backend, not re-implemented here.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Propagates the underlying approve/reject rejection unchanged; returns the LeaveRequestView unchanged (no re-fetch).

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Import LeaveTypeCode, LeaveStatus, LeaveRequestView, and EmployeeProfile from the shared types module; do not redeclare them.

Match the ILeaveService.list/approve/reject signatures exactly (list(): Promise<LeaveRequestView[]>; approve(id): Promise<LeaveRequestView>; reject(id): Promise<LeaveRequestView>) and import ILeaveService from the leave public entry point.
Match the IEmployeeService.getMe(): Promise<EmployeeProfile> signature and import IEmployeeService from the employee public entry point.

The ApprovalsQueueItem fields requestId/employeeId/leaveTypeCode/startDate/endDate/status must map from LeaveRequestView.id/employeeId/leaveTypeCode/startDate/endDate/status, preserving the exact field types declared in the shared types module.

integrationPoints.why: getQueue() reads the visible request list via list(); decide() delegates to approve()/reject().
getQueue() obtains the signed-in profile (id + role) via getMe() to filter out the viewer's own requests.
Canonical source for LeaveTypeCode, LeaveStatus, LeaveRequestView, and EmployeeProfile used by the read-model and service signatures.
